- calendar.mjs SHA-256: 7EEDDF2C89CFB850ED600FA513756AF03E9BA0927746B823468B92F3A1AC6363

The ESM distribution is stored unmodified. It has no runtime dependencies.
Its optional source map is not included. No CDN requests are needed for calendar conversion at runtime.
Solar support: 1000-02-13 through 2050-12-31.
Lunar support: 1000-01-01 through 2050-11-18.

The app applies narrower birth-date bounds in profile.js. Calendar GapJa output is not used as saju pillars: solar-term boundaries and birth-time calculations require a separate engine.
